criteria.reason: Has steps but makes unsupported leaps, e.g., 5 million adults and inconsistent drinker counts.
Labels some assumptions and uncertainty, but does not cleanly separate population data from unsourced per-capita claims.
Provides explicit ranges and error margins, including cup-size and population variants.
Names ICO/Eurostat but gives no verifiable sourced input; population and per-capita figures are unsourced.

factual_errors: Population given as 8.9 million rather than 9,127,100 at end 2025.
Uses 5 million as adult/regular drinker population, inconsistent with Swiss demographics.
Centers estimate on 4 cups/day despite ICO ~1,069 cups/year (~3/day).
summary: The response is stepwise and gives ranges but relies on unsourced per-capita figures, uses an incorrect population, and conflates assumptions with data.
